app.name: Licence Saathi
app.tagline: Indian RTO & Sarathi Parivahan Digital Companion
app.statutory_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Government of India
app.disclaimer: Official prototype for Indian RTO Sarathi Parivahan. Rules and fees per CMVR & state transport departments.

vehicle_classes.name: Motorcycle Without Gear
vehicle_classes.parental_consent_form: Form 2 Part II (Consent by Parent / Legal Guardian)
vehicle_classes.description: Two-wheelers up to 50cc engine capacity, mopeds, and lightweight gearless electric scooters.

vehicle_classes.name: Motorcycle With Gear
vehicle_classes.description: Standard geared motorcycles, motorbikes, and scooters with engine capacity exceeding 50cc.

vehicle_classes.name: Light Motor Vehicle
vehicle_classes.description: Personal passenger cars, hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, and private light utility motor vehicles.

vehicle_classes.name: Commercial & Transport Vehicles
vehicle_classes.description: Taxis, delivery vans, auto-rickshaws, and commercial transport vehicles carrying passengers or goods.

benefits: Contactless paperless verification without visiting RTO for document submission
Instant face authentication / Aadhaar OTP verification on Sarathi Parivahan portal
Zero physical document upload required when pulled directly from DigiLocker

age_proof: 10th Class Marksheet / Passing Certificate (CBSE/ICSE/State Board via DigiLocker)
Birth Certificate issued by Municipal Corporation (DigiLocker verified)
medical_fitness: Form 1: Physical Fitness Self-Declaration (Non-Transport under 40 years)
Form 1A: Medical Certificate signed by Registered Medical Practitioner (Age 40+ or Transport)

application_stages.title: Application Submitted & Fee Paid
application_stages.description: Form 2 application registered and statutory fee paid on Sarathi Parivahan portal.

application_stages.title: Aadhaar e-KYC & Document Scrutiny
application_stages.description: RTO verification officer validating DigiLocker age proof, address proof, and Form 1 medical fitness.

application_stages.title: LL Online Test Slot / Proctoring
application_stages.description: Appointment scheduled for Computer-based Learner's Licence test (STALL) or home online test.

application_stages.title: Learner's Licence Issued (Form 3)
application_stages.description: LL test passed. Digital Form 3 Learner's Licence generated, valid for 6 months across India.

permanent_license_guidelines.prerequisite: Must hold a valid Form 3 Learner's Licence for minimum 30 days
permanent_license_guidelines.maximum_window: Must apply within 180 days (6 months) before Learner's Licence expires
practical_test_requirements: Driving Track Test at Automated Driving Test Track (ADTT) / RTO grounds
Four-Wheeler: Reverse 'S', Parallel Parking, 8-Figure, Gradient/Hill restart without rollback
Two-Wheeler: Serpentine track, emergency braking, balancing at slow speeds
permanent_license_guidelines.outcome: Form 7 (Smart Card Driving Licence) + digital licence in mParivahan & DigiLocker

categories: Traffic Rules of the Road Regulations 1989
